name: Entity Count Tokens
description: Extends the token system to be able to use the number of entities by type.
project_description:
This module displays in the output, using tokens, the number of elements of any entity+bundle.

 Features 
 This module simplifies the work required to display the number of entities of a given type and bundle.

 Post-Installation 
 Once installed and activated, using a token like [entity_count_token:product:book] or [entity_count_token:node:article] it displays the number of products of type book or the number of nodes of type article.

 Additional Requirements 
 Token Filter

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 Entity Count
